Class LobbyController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.GUIController
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.LobbyController
public class LobbyController extends GUIController
The LobbyController class manages the lobby screen of the GUI application, allowing users to interact with available games, create new games, reconnect to a game, or exit the application.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public void init(AvailableGamesDTO state)
      Initializes the lobby view by populating a list of available games and configuring the UI elements. Each game is displayed with its details as a button, allowing the user to join the game.
      Parameters:
      state - The current state containing the list of available games to display in the lobby.

    • onCreateGameButtonClick

      public void onCreateGameButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      Handles the event triggered by clicking the "Create Game" button. This method loads the CreateGame scene, initializes its controller, and updates the GUI
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by clicking the "Create Game" button.

    • onJoinGameButtonClick

      public void onJoinGameButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent, GameInfoDTO state)
      Handles the event triggered when the "Join Game" button is clicked. This method transitions the user to the JoinGame scene, initializes its controller with the provided game information and updates the GUI
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by clicking the "Join Game" button.
      state - The information related to the selected game, such as game ID, level, total players, actual players, and available colors.

    • onReconnectGameButtonClick

      public void onReconnectGameButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      Handles the event triggered by clicking the "Reconnect Game" button. This method transitions to the ReconnectGame scene, initializes its controller and updates the GUI
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by clicking the "Reconnect Game" button.

    • onRefreshGamesButtonClick

      public void onRefreshGamesButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      Handles the event triggered by clicking the "Refresh Games" button. This method requests the virtual client to refresh the list of available games.
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by clicking the "Refresh Games" button.

    • onQuitButtonClick

      public void onQuitButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      Handles the event triggered by clicking the "Quit" button. This method closes the application window and terminates the program.
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by clicking the "Quit" button.
